MessageContainerAcquireLeaseConfirmation:
Are you sure you want to acquire a lease on blob container '%1$s'?

Acquiring a lease will lock the blob container so that it cannot be deleted. Blobs in the container can still be deleted or modified.
MessageContainerAcquireLeaseMultipleConf:
Are you sure you want to acquire a lease on %1$s blob containers?

Acquiring leases will lock the blob containers so that they cannot be deleted. Blobs in the containers can still be deleted or modified.
MessageContainerBreakLeaseConfirmation:
Are you sure you want to break the lease on blob container '%1$s'?

Breaking the lease will allow the blob container to be deleted.
MessageContainerBreakLeaseMultipleConfir:
Are you sure you want to break the lease on %1$s blob containers?

Breaking the leases will allow the blob containers to be deleted.
MessageDeleteBlobContainerConfirm:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete blob container '%1$s' and its contents?

This action cannot be undone.

This action cannot be undone.
